civ.title: Civilization Master
civ.tap_throne: Tap the throne to gather power · +{n} each
civ.offline_desc: You were away for {min} minutes. Your civilization produced:
civ.win_body: You have built a Star-Sea Empire spanning myth, zodiac, divine beasts, cultivation, AI and the cosmos! Mecha phoenixes soar, cyber-qilins guard the AI Heavenly Court, and quantum flying swords streak across the stars. You are truly the Civilization Master.
civ.rank_note: Your current civilization power is {power}. Submit to compete with rulers worldwide.
civ.rank_nick_ph: Pick a title (e.g. Great Sage of Flower-Fruit Mt.)
civ.rank_local_note: Local test environment: you can view the board, but scores are not submitted to the official ranking.
civ.rank_local_toast: Local tests do not submit to the official ranking
civ.rank_empty: The board is empty — claim first place!

0.name: Primitive Era
0.intro: You founded a small village. Farm, mine, trade and conquer to grow it into a mighty empire.

1.name: Zodiac Era
1.intro: Spiritual energy births the twelve zodiac races. Recruit them and choose your bloodline for permanent racial bonuses.

2.name: Divine Beast Era
2.intro: The Beast Continent opens! Collect beast eggs, train and evolve them, and form your beast legion.

3.name: Cultivation Era
3.intro: Qi revives and the immortal path flourishes. Awaken your spirit root, break through realms, found a sect and ascend.

4.name: AI Tech Era
4.intro: A tech explosion! From steam engines to AI, research wonders and build an automated civilization.

5.name: Interstellar Era
5.intro: The cosmos unfolds beneath you. The Moon, Mars, Dyson spheres... build a super-civilization spanning myth and science!

6.name: Genetic Evolution Era
6.intro: Interstellar civilization turns back to rewrite life itself. Zodiac bloodlines and divine beasts gain second forms, making old progress matter again.

7.name: Temporal Civilization Era
7.intro: Your civilization controls chronology. Acceleration, rollback and branching timelines turn waiting into strategy.

8.name: Multiverse Era
8.intro: You no longer rule only one universe. Parallel civilizations, dark-energy expeditions and multi-line income open a wider frontier.

9.name: Mind Upload Era
9.intro: AI and cultivation finally merge. Artifact spirits, digital golden cores and quantum flying swords become real systems.

10.name: Creator Era
10.intro: Spend origin matter to restart the universe and gain permanent laws. An ending becomes fuel for the next cycle.

11.name: Dao Fruit Cycle Era
11.intro: Civilization has no hard endpoint. Dao fruit, seasonal laws and new ranking goals give every loop a new chase.

dungeon_desc.wolf: Wipe out the wolves harassing your village.
dungeon_desc.beast: A lair-defense battle deep in the Beast Continent.
dungeon_desc.secret: Sect disciples explore a qi-rich realm.
dungeon_desc.tribul: Seize heavenly essence amid the lightning tribulation.
dungeon_desc.ai: An assault on the robot legion.
dungeon_desc.dna: Recover gene samples capable of rewriting bloodlines from lost-species ruins.
dungeon_desc.time: Enter a fractured timeline and seize chronos that can compress waiting.
dungeon_desc.dark: Cross the boundary of parallel universes and harvest dark energy.

z_snake.name: Mystic Genome Snake Clan
z_snake.desc: Snake bloodline tier 2: qi +80%, gene points +30%.

z_monkey.name: Sage Ape Clan
z_monkey.desc: Monkey bloodline tier 2: tech +80%, gene points +25%.

b_azure.name: Starvault Azure Dragon
b_azure.desc: Azure Dragon mutation: qi +45%, star energy +25%.

b_qilin.name: Cyber Qilin
b_qilin.desc: Qilin mutation: all output +25%, gene points +35%.

ui.tap_hint: Tap the throne to gather power · +
ui.reset_confirm: Reset your civilization? All progress will be lost.
ui.panel_tech: AI Tech · Research the tech tree
ui.zodiac_note: Pick one bloodline for a powerful exclusive bonus (changeable); each recruited zodiac adds +3% to all output. Recruiting costs gold.
ui.beast_egg_desc: Hatch a random beast with gold; each grants an all-output bonus (stacks up to 5 of a kind).
ui.cultivate_note: Spend qi to break through realms; each greatly boosts the all-output multiplier. Current ×{mult}
ui.evolve_note: Spend gene points to activate second forms. Zodiac evolutions require recruitment; beast mutations require hatching the original.
ui.war_note: Army power is the combined strength of buildings, zodiac, beasts, realm and tech. Win rate depends on power vs. requirement; victory yields resources and beast eggs.
ui.victory_egg: You also captured a divine beast!
ui.defeat_body: Your army was outmatched and retreated. Build up power and try again.

fusion.2: 🐉 Dragon clansmen begin to cultivate immortal arts...
fusion.3: ⚔️ Cultivators pilot mechs, quantum flying swords unsheathed!
fusion.4: 🤖 AI takes command of the beast legion — the cyber-qilin appears!
fusion.5: 🌌 Mecha phoenixes guard the AI Heavenly Court. Your super-civilization spans myth, cultivation, science and the cosmos!
fusion.6: 🧬 Gene labs rewrite bloodlines; zodiac clans and divine beasts gain second forms.
fusion.7: ⏳ Timelines begin to branch, and waiting itself becomes a resource.
fusion.8: 🕳️ Parallel civilizations feed power through the dark-energy network.
fusion.9: 🧠 AI, souls and artifact spirits merge into the spirit net.
fusion.10: 🌱 Origin matter hardens into laws; restarting the universe becomes growth.
fusion.11: ♾️ Dao fruit cycles begin, opening endless seasonal loops.
